name: inbox
title: Inbox
description: The notification Inbox: frame with header actions, All | Unread chips, sticky day groups, full-bleed rows with avatar or icon and an unread tint (no dot), rich titles, action chips, a fixed right column with the time over the hover actions (read toggle and menu), and empty, loading and error states.

meta.whenToUse: The notifications panel: a feed of person and system events the user reads, acts on and marks read. Put it in a Sheet, Popover or docked panel.
meta.whenNotToUse: Toasts for transient confirmations, an activity log on a record (Timeline), or a bare unread count (NotificationBell).
